mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( host_user_id, host_user_nickname, name, description, place_type, area_size, capacity, allows_small_dog, allows_medium_dog, allows_large_dog, provides_home_camera, provides_realtime_photo, provides_yard, provides_walk, other_options, hourly_price, nightly_price, status ) VALUES ( #{hostUserId}, #{hostUserNickname}, #{name}, #{description}, #{placeType}, #{areaSize}, #{capacity}, #{allowsSmallDog}, #{allowsMediumDog}, #{allowsLargeDog}, #{providesHomeCamera}, #{providesRealtimePhoto}, #{providesYard}, #{providesWalk}, #{otherOptions}, #{hourlyPrice}, #{nightlyPrice}, #{status} )
INSERT INTO place_addresses ( place_id, sido, sigungu, road_address ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{sido}, #{sigungu}, #{roadAddress} )

INSERT INTO place_addresses ( place_id, sido, sigungu, road_address ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{sido}, #{sigungu}, #{roadAddress} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sido = VALUES(sido), sigungu = VALUES(sigungu), road_address = VALUES(road_address), latitude = NULL, longitude = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, host_user_id AS hostUserId, name, host_user_nickname AS hostUserNickname, place_type AS placeType, area_size AS areaSize, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, nightly_price AS nightlyPrice, average_rating AS averageRating, supports_hourly AS supportsHourly, supports_package AS supportsPackage, package_check_in_time AS packageCheckInTime, package_check_out_time AS packageCheckOutTime FROM places WHERE id = #{placeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.name, p.description, p.place_type AS placeType, p.area_size AS areaSize, p.capacity, p.allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, p.allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, p.allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, p.provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, p.provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, p.provides_yard AS providesYard, p.provides_walk AS providesWalk, p.other_options AS otherOptions, CASE WHEN p.other_options IS NOT NULL AND p.other_options <> '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS otherOptionsEnabled, p.hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, p.nightly_price AS nightlyPrice, pa.sigungu, pa.road_address AS roadAddress FROM places p LEFT JOIN place_addresses pa ON pa.place_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{placeId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.host_user_nickname AS nickname, p.name, p.description, p.place_type AS placeType, p.allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, p.allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, p.allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, p.provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, p.provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, p.provides_yard AS providesYard, p.provides_walk AS providesWalk, p.hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, pa.latitude AS latitude, pa.longitude AS longitude FROM places p LEFT JOIN place_addresses pa ON pa.place_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.is_visible = TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT id, host_user_id AS hostUserId, host_user_nickname AS nickname, name, description, place_type AS placeType, area_size AS areaSize, capacity, allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, provides_yard AS providesYard, provides_walk AS providesWalk, other_options AS otherOptions, hourly_price AS hourlyPrice, nightly_price AS nightlyPrice, supports_hourly AS supportsHourly, supports_package AS supportsPackage, package_check_in_time AS packageCheckInTime, package_check_out_time AS packageCheckOutTime, status, is_visible AS visible FROM places WHERE id = #{placeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET supports_hourly = #{supportsHourly}, supports_package = #{supportsPackage}, package_check_in_time = #{packageCheckInTime}, package_check_out_time = #{packageCheckOutTime} WHERE id = #{placeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE places SET name = #{request.name}, description = #{request.description}, place_type = #{request.placeType}, area_size = #{request.areaSize}, capacity = #{request.capacity}, allows_small_dog = #{request.allowsSmallDog}, allows_medium_dog = #{request.allowsMediumDog}, allows_large_dog = #{request.allowsLargeDog}, provides_home_camera = #{request.providesHomeCamera}, provides_realtime_photo = #{request.providesRealtimePhoto}, provides_yard = #{request.providesYard}, provides_walk = #{request.providesWalk}, other_options = #{otherOptions}, hourly_price = #{request.hourlyPrice}, nightly_price = #{request.nightlyPrice} WHERE id = #{placeId} AND host_user_id = #{hostUserId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE places p SET p.average_rating = ( SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rv.rating), 0) FROM reviews rv JOIN reservations rs ON rs.id = rv.reservation_id WHERE rs.place_id = p.id AND rv.deleted_at IS NULL ) WHERE p.id = #{placeId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.host_user_nickname AS nickname, p.name, p.description, p.place_type AS placeType, p.allows_small_dog AS allowsSmallDog, p.allows_medium_dog AS allowsMediumDog, p.allows_large_dog AS allowsLargeDog, p.provides_home_camera AS providesHomeCamera, p.provides_realtime_photo AS providesRealtimePhoto, p.provides_yard AS providesYard, p.provides_walk AS providesWalk, p.hourly_price AS hourlyPrice,
pa.latitude AS latitude, pa.longitude AS longitude FROM places p LEFT JOIN place_addresses pa ON pa.place_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.is_visible = TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.host_user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND pa.sigungu IN
#{region}
AND p.place_type = #{placeType}
AND p.capacity >= #{petCount}
AND p.allows_small_dog = TRUE
AND p.allows_medium_dog = TRUE
AND p.allows_large_dog = TRUE
AND p.supports_hourly = TRUE AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_availability s WHERE s.place_id = p.id AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND s.start_at >= #{startAt} AND s.end_at <= #{endAt}) = #{requiredSlots}
AND p.supports_package = TRUE AND p.package_check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND p.package_check_out_time IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_availability s WHERE s.place_id = p.id AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND s.start_at >= TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, p.package_check_in_time) AND s.end_at <= TIMESTAMP(#{endDate}, p.package_check_out_time)) = TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, TIMESTAMP(#{startDate}, p.package_check_in_time), TIMESTAMP(#{endDate}, p.package_check_out_time)) / 3
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_availability s WHERE s.place_id = p.id AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND s.start_at >= #{startAt} AND s.end_at <= #{endAt})
ORDER BY p.hourly_price ASC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.average_rating DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT pa.sigungu FROM place_addresses pa JOIN places p ON p.id = pa.place_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.is_visible = TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pa.sigungu
